# NY Engineers

> > NY Engineers provides MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) and fire protection engineering services for buildings across New York City and beyond, specializing in code compliance, energy efficiency, and sustainable design.

The firm offers comprehensive building systems design including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and fire protection services for diverse project types from restaurants and hotels to educational facilities and franchises. NY Engineers helps clients navigate NYC's complex building codes and energy laws including Local Law 97, 84, and 87, while maximizing incentives like Con Edison programs and 179D tax deductions.

## Key Topics

- MEP Engineering
- Local Law 97 (LL97)
- Local Law 87 (LL87)
- Local Law 84 (LL84)
- Fire Protection Design
- HVAC Design
- Plumbing Design
- Energy Efficiency
- NYC Building Code Compliance
- Con Edison Incentives
- 179D Tax Deduction
- Fire Alarm Systems
- Natural Gas Piping
- Building Energy Audits
- NFPA Standards

## NYC Energy Laws & Compliance

- [NYC Energy Laws & Incentives: Your 2025 Compliance Guide](https://www.ny-engineers.com/blog/nyc-energy-laws-incentives-your-2025-compliance-guide): Local Law 97, 84, 87 compliance guide with 179D tax incentives for 2025
- [An Overview on Con Edison Residential Incentives in 2022](https://www.ny-engineers.com/blog/con-edison-residential-incentives-in-2022-an-overview): Con Edison residential incentives for energy efficiency in NYC & Westchester
- [Electricity Rates in NYC: An Overview and Insights](https://www.ny-engineers.com/blog/overview-of-electricity-rates-in-nyc): NYC electricity rates, demand charges, and Con Edison billing explained
- [Will Local Law 26 of 2004 Affect My Building?](https://www.ny-engineers.com/blog/does-local-law-26-of-2004-affect-my-building): Local Law 26 sprinkler requirements for NYC high-rise office buildings
- [NYC Code Compliance in Flue Design: Key Requirements Explained](https://www.ny-engineers.com/blog/nyc-code-compliance-and-flue-design): NYC Building Code requirements for flue design and combustion systems
